permission.request: Explain purpose before requesting OS notification permission from SettingsScreen; denial preserves check-in, foreground sync and inbox.
permission.refresh: Check current OS permission at initialization and each foreground resume; changed permission invalidates schedule / registration cache keys before sync and notification updates.
permission.nativeAcceptance: Android API36 ARM64 emulator denied / allowed permission and pending-scheduling assertions passed in notification-native-proof.json. Actual local delivery / native click are proven separately for recorded APKs in native-reminder proofs.

reminderScheduling.execution: Serialized promise tail with schedule epoch and active-key guards; commit last schedule key only after an active plan succeeds.
reminderScheduling.offlineFailure: Fetch tasks before replacing alarms; a fetch failure leaves previously scheduled reminders intact.
reminderScheduling.replacement: Cancel only pending requests whose payload kind is task_reminder or contains task_id; preserve unrelated and already displayed partner notifications.
reminderScheduling.logout: Increment schedule epoch to invalidate asynchronous plans, clear cached registration / schedule state, then serialize cancelAll after pending work.
reminderScheduling.planningWindow: Seven civil dates from the current space's date, not seven added 24-hour durations.
reminderScheduling.timezoneRules: For each date, use the latest accepted effective timezone rule; UTC / GMT aliases resolve to tz.UTC.
reminderScheduling.taskTerms: Current executor only; accepted versions, effective enable / pause state, weekdays, end date and personal rest dates.
reminderScheduling.todayVersion: Prefer the version matching today's frozen task_version_id when present; fall back to the latest available accepted version only if unmatched; skip today's completed instance.
reminderScheduling.quietHours: Shift a reminder in quiet hours to the local civil end time, including overnight and DST boundaries.
reminderScheduling.capacity: Future reminders sorted by time; take at most 60 to leave iOS notification capacity for partner alerts.
reminderScheduling.androidMode: inexactAllowWhileIdle; this is not an exact-delivery guarantee.

lockScreenPrivacy.localDefault: 留一点时间，完成和 TA 的小约定。
lockScreenPrivacy.detailsEnabled: Local task title or authorized foreground partner event short text.

remoteForeground.authorization: Fetch notification by notification_id from the API, verify account / session and space before showing.
remoteForeground.preferences: Respect checkins / interactions / rewards categories and space-zone quiet hours.
remoteForeground.failure: Inbox remains the source of truth if an alert cannot be authorized; sync only for the same account / session.
remoteForeground.registration: Token registration and response handling verify account / session; failed registration keeps registrationError and is not evidence of delivered push.

tapRouting.initialGuard: Verify space and any account_id, sync, then verify the same account / session.
tapRouting.remote: Read the authorized notification ID and mark read, then route by event to orders / milestones / tasks / feed; failure opens inbox.
tapRouting.local: Go to root and explicitly select Today after the next frame instead of retaining another selected destination.
tapRouting.restorationGuard: Pending taps stay held while initializing; process only after current account / snapshot restoration completes.

notifications.evidenceLimit: Current source, 30 passed host tests, startup→logout→login real HTTP/PostgreSQL Android integration, native permission / pending scheduling assertions, and actual local reminder delivery / native click for recorded emulator APKs. Original F1–F6 visual scope remains; startup's two captures have a separate bounded ship. APNs / FCM delivery, iOS and physical phones remain unverified.

exportSharing.authorization: Fetch only the user's authorized space export.
exportSharing.temporaryFile: After calling system share, delete the existing temporary JSON in finally on both success and share failure.

evidence.dispositionScope: F1–F6 only, all resolved by the same reviewer against the supplied Android emulator captures.
evidence.captureLimit: Static Android emulator captures; no iOS compile, target hardware, production push, full product acceptance, independent motion, keyboard, dark appearance or launcher assessment.

notificationTapTests.scope: Dart widget routing: authorized remote ID lookup, old-account isolation, and local reminder returning to Today; not native tap delivery.

hostTests.startupCoverage: Serialized cold initialization, late secure-storage session guards, sanitized corrupt restore and boot→first login→logout→second login.

androidPermissionIntegration.case: integration_test/core_flow_test.dart with real development HTTP / PostgreSQL
checks: Native partner_events and task_reminders channels exist.
Pending task reminders exist only with OS permission allowed.
Payload is scoped to current account and space.
Default lock-screen body contains no task title.
androidPermissionIntegration.limits: Local permission and scheduling assertions only; excludes actual local alarm delivery / native taps, APNs / FCM delivery, iOS and physical phones.

apkBuild.result: assembleDebug succeeded; main app APK rebuilt.

notificationFollowup.realPush: APNs / FCM actual delivery remains unverified.
notificationFollowup.visualScope: Original nine captures and F1–F6 only, plus a separately bounded two-capture startup ship; no normal page composition change.

historical.scope: Historical old APK; actual local alarm delivered after prior app process killed and native tap rebuilt Today.

newerRecorded.scope: Newer recorded APK; actual local alarm delivered, native tap showed restoration semantics then authenticated Today; final login correction is separately covered by current host / integration checks.

checks: Native alarm actually posted after inactive app process.
Wallet available / balance remained 5; permanent XP remained 1.
Notification payload scoped to the recorded account and space.
nativeLocalReminder.screenshotProvenance: Initial blank PNG discarded. Startup/restored PNGs retaken after rendered semantics confirmed on the same recorded APK under actual six-second GET /auth/me dev API latency. Target-visible PNG follows a scroll; native tap semantics recorded separately.
nativeLocalReminder.experimentCleanup: Temporary latency middleware / container removed; original API / database / worker restored; real /health ok and /ready ready.
nativeLocalReminder.limits: Local main-program Android emulator reminder and startup only; no exact-time / cross-device guarantee, APNs / FCM delivery, iOS or physical phones.

latestStartupIntegration.environment: Android API36 ARM64 emulator; real development HTTP / PostgreSQL
latestStartupIntegration.setup: Save real session then await app.init(); do not prefill controller.user / sid.
latestStartupIntegration.checks: Task acceptance / check-in / orders / allowed native notifications / settings logout / login restores same space, wallet balance 5 and completed order.
latestStartupIntegration.scope: Latest login correction; emulator integration, not physical hardware or APNs / FCM.

startupVisualReview.scope: Only Android restoration and transition into the previously reviewed Today shell. Original nine-capture F1–F6 scope remains independent.
startupVisualReview.provenance: Valid same-recorded-APK retakes under actual six-second dev /auth/me latency; pre-paint blank capture excluded; latency middleware removed.
startupVisualReview.lastSourceCorrection: Explicit login _restoreAccount after cold init; visual composition unchanged.
startupVisualReview.limits: No all-startup-failure, enlarged-font-startup, animation-performance, dark-theme, iOS, physical-phone or whole-product acceptance.

motionPolicy.behavior: When reduced, render pose 0 and skip idle blinking.
motionPolicy.evidence: Source-observed; static visual captures do not verify motion timing, OS preference changes or target-device performance.

sessionState.route: GoRouter protects initializing / user / needsLogin / sid; root shows _StartupScreen while restoring; settings also guards null user; logout goes to '/'.
sessionState.controller: Cold init is serialized once. Login / logout wait initialization and active sync; login explicitly restores the new account. Generation checks prevent stale sync writes; WebSocket callbacks verify socket identity and generation.
sessionState.api: Session generation changes on token install / clear; stale request / refresh responses throw SESSION_CHANGED; restore checks generation after secure-storage read.
sessionState.evidence: Source-observed behavior with 30 host tests and latest emulator startup→logout→login HTTP / PostgreSQL integration; recorded native reminder APKs retain their own provenance.

startupState.initialization: AppController.init memoizes one serialized cold-restore Future; initializing true until finally.
startupState.restore: Restore secure tokens, profile, active account space, cached snapshot and local queue; sync current server state.
startupState.login: Login / logout await initialization and active sync. Login explicitly calls _restoreAccount after installing the new session; completed cold initialization is not reused as account restoration.
startupState.apiGuard: Api.restore verifies session generation after the secure-storage read before installing restored tokens.
startupState.corruptRestore: Clear in-memory user / sid / snapshot / pending, set needsLogin and sanitized error 本机会话恢复失败，请重新登录。; attempt clearing secure session/profile. Does not claim all SQLite cache was deleted.
startupState.notificationGate: Hold update / registration / scheduling and pending notification routing while initializing.
startupState.evidenceLimit: Two captured Android restoration states and the existing Today transition; no all-failure, enlarged-font-startup, animation-performance, iOS or physical-phone acceptance.

rules.password: 10–128 Unicode code points after trimming, matching existing server behavior

authInputRecovery.fieldErrors: server field_errors applied beside known fields; editing clears matching error without erasing input
authInputRecovery.activationSuccessLoginFailure: switch to login and preserve credentials; never automatically reuse the consumed activation code
authInputRecovery.evidenceScope: Android emulator normal and error captures; host tests; not physical user login acceptance

narrative.northStar: 两只小猫，一起在温暖书桌前学习
narrative.overview:
这是已实现的 Flutter 手机界面记录。温暖木桌、书本、台灯、植物与月夜窗景形成共同小屋，两只奶油橘猫与灰白猫保持不同毛色。像素插画承担陪伴与纪念，中文标题、说明、表单、任务勾选和导航由原生控件独立绘制。

界面延续用户已定的奶油、深棕、珊瑚与鼠尾草绿世界。Material 3 的表单和导航承载真实操作；视觉密度随手机高度调整，以待完成约定的标题与操作优先。此处记录实际结果，不重新选择风格，也不把概念图中的日期、余额或等级作为产品数据。
keyCharacteristics: 分层像素房间、独立两猫与解锁纪念，文字和触区保持原生。
奶油页面、浅纸内容、深棕正文、珊瑚操作、鼠尾草绿完成。
四入口：今日、小屋、奖励、成长；通知与设置在顶部。
普通约定直接勾选，离线状态和服务端余额有独立表达。
永久纪念经验与当前有效学习事实分别显示。

rules.name: The Contrast Roles Rule
rules.body: 珊瑚填充与珊瑚文字是两个不同角色。保留 coral 主填充，操作文案使用 coral-ink；填充按钮使用 button-ink，导航图标使用 ink。

rules.name: The Independent Chinese Rule
rules.body: 标题、余额、日期、任务标准、状态和按钮文字独立于位图，使用正常文本与可换行布局。不能把概念图里的文字或数值烘焙进应用素材。

rules.name: The Paper Surface Rule
rules.body: 任务与记录使用 paper 的色面与 line 边界表达结构，沿用当前平面容器；不可把素材内的阴影当作通用组件阴影。

rules.name: The Memorial and Facts Rule
rules.body: 今日／小屋的经验、等级和装饰属于永久纪念；成长页的有效完成数、有效学习天数、C 次数和日历属于更正后的学习事实。撤销不使纪念装饰倒退，却可以改变有效统计，两者不能互相替代。

dos: Do 保留用户已定的奶油、珊瑚、鼠尾草绿、温暖木桌与两只不同毛色像素猫。
Do 使用独立中文文本、原生控件和当前像素网格图标，让真实任务可直接勾选。
Do 延续当前最小 48×48 logical px 按钮设置，并为图标操作提供明确标签；新增页面仍需对应设备与辅助功能验证。
Do 按实际屏幕高度与文字缩放安排内容，保留短屏待完成标题和操作优先。
Do 明确区分可用余额、待同步操作、永久纪念经验和当前有效统计。
Do 把截图、源码和日志的证据范围写清楚，保持 Android 六项视觉修正与整体产品验收的边界。
donts: Don't 覆写根 DESIGN.md、DEVELOPMENT.md 或 GOAL.md，也不要用本视觉记录替代功能合同。
Don't 重开风格选择，或把整页概念图当作实际界面后覆盖透明触区。
Don't 把概念图、开发验收截图或 sidecar 预览中的数值、奖品和状态注入生产默认数据。
Don't 用永久经验或纪念徽章冒充实时有效学习次数和日历。
Don't 在余额不足时展示可执行的兑换，或在待同步时显示积分已经入账。
Don't 从本轮静态 Android 捕获宣称 iOS、硬件、推送、全部状态、动效或完整产品已经验收。
